posts.title: Networking my way into a new job
posts.description: I left Fern and started a new job a few days ago, a job I got solely from networking.

posts.title: A pretty good summer of reading
posts.description: I read 19 books this summer (which I’m defining as June through August), and the publication dates ranged from 1858 to 2026. Five of the 19 were nonfiction (more than my typical annual total of nonfiction books); two were translated. Summer is usually my biggest reading time, but I’m not exactly sure why?
